# Abramson & Company LLC

> > Abramson & Company LLC is a CPA firm based in Westport, Connecticut, founded by Ray Abramson in 2005. The firm serves small business owners, real estate professionals, professional service providers, retail businesses, and not-for-profits throughout Fairfield County, the tri-state area of CT, NY, and NJ, the Bay Area, and nationwide. Abramson blends CPA-led expertise with genuine personal relationships, offering bundled bookkeeping, tax, payroll, and advisory services for a fixed monthly fee, supported by a secure online platform for real-time collaboration and personalized tax strategies.
